status: Step 2 DSLD batch specification; not the final full-graph schema
scope: All 400 labels pinned by the saved DSLD baseline audit; selected fields only
tables: Reuse base-contract table shapes and source-scoped identity rules; terminology/clinical/graph stages are not run
normalization: Separate trimmed display name and NFC/casefolded whitespace-normalized search key
Exact decimal conversion of supported plain mass units to mg
Preserve original amount, operator, serving basis and all source fields
Preserve missing, null, empty, NP and conflicting states
No activity-to-mass, mass-to-volume, per-unit or daily-dose derivation

comparison_policy.eligible: Successful plain-mass representation with known basis, resolved serving, and no blocking quantity/source conflict
comparison_policy.pending: Representation may exist but missing basis, zero, source range or serving-resolution issues prevent unqualified comparison
comparison_policy.blocked: No supported mass representation; NP, conflict, invalid amount or unsupported unit/operator
comparison_policy.inequalities: Keep original operator; eligibility never means equivalence to an exact amount
comparison_policy.identity: Comparison does not establish ingredient or product equivalence

review_policy: Preserve all saved quantity-audit findings with source pointers, including serving-level issues; no source corrections
reference_scope: selected_dsld_collection; out-of-sample targets are not declared nonexistent
validation: 400 labels and independent recursive path reconciliation
